mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sync_session (token_hash, account_id, expires_at) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{accountId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL 7 DAY)
mapper.select: SELECT account_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, expires_at) AS ttl_seconds FROM sync_session WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
